# Fresh Coast AI

> Practical AI adoption for businesses ready to own it. Fixed-fee engagements from readiness assessment to implementation. Founded by Jon Linton in Milwaukee, Wisconsin.

Fresh Coast AI helps businesses across the United States adopt AI confidently. We are vendor-neutral, people-first, and every engagement is designed to end — your team owns the capability when we're done.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://freshcoast.ai/): Overview of Fresh Coast AI's approach to AI consulting
- [About](https://freshcoast.ai/about.html): Background on founder Jon Linton — 13 years in change management, international business development, and AI transformation
- [Services](https://freshcoast.ai/services.html): AI consulting service tiers, pricing, and what's included
- [How We Work](https://freshcoast.ai/how-we-work.html): The Assess → Build → Own methodology
- [Deliverables](https://freshcoast.ai/deliverables.html): Sample deliverables clients receive

## Service Tiers & Pricing

- AI Strategy Session: $1,000 — focused session to identify top AI opportunities
- AI Readiness Assessment: Starting around $5,000 — full organizational AI readiness evaluation
- AI Implementation: $8,000–$55,000 — end-to-end workflow design, build, and team training
